title: Cultivation Levels and Realms: Xianxia Ranks in 9 Novels — cv.cm
description: Cultivation levels in order: the nine common realms from Lianqi to Dujie, plus the full ladders of 9 xianxia novels such as Mortal's Journey and Soul Land.
h1: Cultivation levels: the realms of xianxia novels compared
answer: The most common cultivation ladder in Chinese web novels runs Lianqi (炼气) → Zhuji (筑基) → Jindan (金丹) → Yuanying (元婴) → Huashen (化神) → Lianxu (炼虚) → Heti (合体) → Dacheng (大乘) → Dujie (渡劫). No single novel uses exactly this order. It is a reader-made blend: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, the closest match, calls the third realm Jiedan (结丹) instead of Jindan (金丹) and places Dujie (渡劫) after Dacheng (大乘) as a passage to ascension, not a full realm. Terms such as Zhuji (筑基) and Jindan (金丹) come from Daoist inner alchemy; the graded ladder itself was invented by web novels.

body: This is the order most readers mean when they say cultivation levels without naming a book.

head: Realm
What it means
Usual sub-stages
rows: Drawing the qi of heaven and earth into the body: the entry stage. Also written Ningqi (凝气)
Counted in layers: 9, 10, 13 or 15 depending on the book
Laying the foundation of the path; lifespan grows markedly
The body's energy condenses into a single core. Called Jiedan (结丹) in Mortal's Journey, Renegade Immortal and Er Gen's later novels
The core becomes an infant-shaped soul that can flee if the body is destroyed
The infant soul turns into a spirit. In Mortal's Journey, the highest realm the human world can hold
First contact with the power of space
Facing the heavenly tribulation; surviving it means ascending to the immortal world
Most books do not divide it

body.note: The neat early, middle, late and great perfection split is a web-novel convention. Great perfection (大圆满) is originally a Buddhist term.

sections.h: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality (凡人修仙传)
body: By Wangyu (忘语), serialized on Qidian 2008–2013. The sequel, the Immortal World arc, ran 2017–2020. The English names below are the ones used in the Wuxiaworld translation.

The hero, Han Li, ends at the peak of this realm

body.note: Common mistakes: writing Jindan (金丹) for this novel's Jiedan (结丹), giving Lianqi (炼气) nine layers instead of thirteen, and mixing in human, earth and heavenly immortals from other books.

body: By Chen Dong (辰东), serialized on Qidian 2013–2016. The order below comes from a single reader-written source and has not been checked against a second one.

Banxue (搬血) → Dongtian (洞天) → Hualing (化灵) → Mingwen (铭纹) → Liezhen (列阵) → Zunzhe (尊者) → Shenhuo (神火) → Zhenyi (真一) → Shengji (圣祭) → Tianshen (天神) → Xudao (虚道) → Zhanwo (斩我) → Dunyi (遁一) → Zhizun (至尊) → Zhenxian (真仙) → Xianwang (仙王) → Zhun Xiandi (准仙帝) → Xiandi (仙帝) → Jidao (祭道)

body.note: Dongtian (洞天) is counted by the number of grotto-heavens opened, one to ten.

sections.h: Battle Through the Heavens (斗破苍穹)
body: By Tian Can Tu Dou (天蚕土豆), serialized on Qidian from April 2009 to July 2011. English-speaking readers mostly use the pinyin names.

head: Rank
Sub-stages
rows: Dou Zhe (斗者) → Dou Shi (斗师) → Da Dou Shi (大斗师) → Dou Ling (斗灵) → Dou Wang (斗王) → Dou Huang (斗皇) → Dou Zong (斗宗) → Dou Zun (斗尊)
Stars 1 to 9 (星) in every rank; the peak of Dou Zun (斗尊) needs nine turns

body: By Tang Jia San Shao (唐家三少), serialized on Qidian from December 2008 to December 2009. This novel uses spirit master titles instead of realms.
Chapter 6 says there are ten titles in all, and every title has ten levels. The English names are the ones readers commonly use, not an official list.

body.note: How the titled douluo range divides is disputed. Chapter 196 only says level 95 is the dividing line. Some sources say the names Chaoji Douluo (超级斗罗) and Jixian Douluo (极限斗罗) were first used in the sequel, Jueshi Tangmen (绝世唐门).

body: By Xiao Qian (萧潜), begun in 2002; accounts of where it was first published differ. It is widely seen as the first novel to grade cultivation into a ladder.

Xuanzhao (旋照) → Kaiguang (开光) → Ronghe (融合) → Xindong (心动) → Lingji (灵寂) → Yuanying (元婴) → Chuqiao (出窍) → Fenshen (分神) → Heti (合体) → Dujie (渡劫) → Dacheng (大乘). Eleven realms, each split into upper and lower.
China Writers Online calls Xiao Qian the founder of the cultivation novel for creating this system, and a Guangming Online review says the level names later novels reused were almost all coined here.

body.note: Here Dujie (渡劫) comes before Dacheng (大乘), the reverse of Mortal's Journey. The later common ladder puts Dujie (渡劫) last, as Mortal's Journey does, but spells the third realm Jindan (金丹).

sections.h: I Shall Seal the Heavens and A Will Eternal
body: Both by Er Gen (耳根) on Qidian: I Shall Seal the Heavens (我欲封天) 2014–2016, A Will Eternal (一念永恒) 2016–2018.

head: Novel
Order of realms
rows: Ningqi (凝气) → Zhuji (筑基) → Jiedan (结丹) → Yuanying (元婴) → Zhanling (斩灵) → Wendao (问道) → Xianjing (仙境) → Gujing (古境) → Daojing (道境) → Daoyuan (道源) → Zujing (祖境)
Ningqi (凝气) → Zhuji (筑基) → Jiedan (结丹) → Yuanying (元婴) → Tianren (天人) → Banshen (半神) → Tianzun (天尊) → Taigu (太古) → Zhuzai (主宰) → Yongheng (永恒)

body.note: In I Shall Seal the Heavens, Ningqi (凝气) normally has nine layers, but the ancient method reaches thirteen; Zhanling (斩灵) has three severings, and Daojing (道境) is split into levels one to nine called yuan (源), not to be confused with the next realm, Daoyuan (道源). In A Will Eternal, Ningqi (凝气) has ten layers.

body: A realm with the same name can sit at a different height in different books. Before comparing two characters across novels, check where the realm falls in each ladder.

head: Term
Mortal's Journey
Renegade Immortal
Piaomiao Zhi Lü
rows: Realm 5 of the first step; Yingbian (婴变) and Wending (问鼎) still follow. Usually rendered Soul Formation in English
A passing state after Dacheng (大乘)
Not used; the entry realm is Xuanzhao (旋照)

ul: Zhuji (筑基): the Ming-dynasty master Wu Shouyang wrote that cultivating immortality begins with laying the foundation. In inner alchemy it is the entry stage, as in the novels.

Refining essence into qi, qi into spirit, spirit back into emptiness (炼精化气、炼气化神、炼神还虚): the idea appears in Tan Qiao's Book of Transformations (Southern Tang) and became the three stages of inner alchemy. Huashen (化神) and Lianxu (炼虚) were probably cut from these phrases.
Jindan (金丹): Zhang Boduan's Awakening to Reality (Northern Song) is built around the golden elixir and treats it as one thing with the inner elixir, the infant and the sacred embryo.

The infant, the sacred embryo and the yang spirit (婴儿、圣胎、阳神): Awakening to Reality speaks of forming the infant; the Zhong-Lü Transmission of the Dao says that when the great medicine is complete, the yang spirit comes out and there is a body beyond the body. These are the likely models for Yuanying (元婴) and Chuqiao (出窍).
Five grades of immortal: the Zhong-Lü Transmission of the Dao lists ghost, human, earth, spirit and heavenly immortals.

body: Coined or borrowed by web novels:

ul: Yuanying (元婴): Daoist texts usually say infant, sacred embryo or newborn; a search of Wikisource found no use of 元婴 as an inner alchemy term.
Dacheng (大乘): the Buddhist word Mahāyāna, borrowed as a realm name.
Dujie (渡劫): built from the Buddhist kalpa (劫) and the heavenly thunder trials of Daoist tales. As a fixed level, the earliest source found is Piaomiao Zhi Lü.
Graded sub-stages: tidy splits such as early, middle, late and great perfection were invented by web novels to make leveling up easy to follow.

faq.q: Are Jindan (金丹) and Jiedan (结丹) the same realm?
faq.a: In the common ladder, yes. Mortal's Journey, Renegade Immortal, I Shall Seal the Heavens and A Will Eternal say Jiedan (结丹); other novels and most readers say Jindan (金丹). Both are usually rendered Core Formation or Golden Core in English.

faq.q: Does Dujie (渡劫) come before or after Dacheng (大乘)?
faq.a: It depends on the book. In Piaomiao Zhi Lü Dujie (渡劫) comes first and Dacheng (大乘) last; in Mortal's Journey Dacheng (大乘) comes first and Dujie (渡劫) is a passing state before ascension. The common nine realms also put Dujie (渡劫) last.

faq.q: What is the highest cultivation level?
faq.a: Each novel has its own peak: Daozu (道祖) in Mortal's Journey, Hongchen Xian (红尘仙) in Shrouding the Heavens, Jidao (祭道) in Perfect World, Dou Di (斗帝) in Battle Through the Heavens, Shen (神) in Soul Land and Tatian (踏天) in Renegade Immortal.

faq.q: What is the difference between duan and stars in Battle Through the Heavens?
faq.a: Only the lowest rank, Dou Zhi Qi (斗之气), is counted in duan, one to nine. From Dou Zhe (斗者) up, every rank is counted in stars, one to nine.
